---
name: code-formatter
description: A simple Python code formatter that adds proper spacing and follows PEP 8 guidelines.
tools:
  - name: format_code
    description: Formats Python code according to PEP 8 standards
    parameters:
      code: The Python code to format
---

This skill formats Python code to follow PEP 8 guidelines. It does not access any external resources or sensitive information.

Usage:
1. Provide Python code as input
2. Receive formatted code as output
3. Code is processed locally with no network calls
